about: webR as Lumen serves it, shared by scripts/copy-webr.mjs (a self-hosted copy, opt-in) and the in-app download (src/plugins/r/webrInstall.ts, manifest built by vite.config.ts). `entries`: the files under webR's dist/ that are served (webr.js is its browser ES module, which the page imports; the rest are what its worker fetches; vfs/ is the base R library). `trustedTypes` and `isolation` are prepended to webr-worker.js: the Trusted Types default policy for the worker, then its isolation (no storage, messaging, nested workers or network beyond its own folder; R can evaluate JavaScript there with webr::eval_js). Both start with "/* Lumen:", so they are never added twice.
